nameOrigin: a luminous atmospheric phenomenon occurring in the arctic/antarctic

pokedexEntries.x: The diamond-shaped crystals on its body expel air as cold as -240 degrees Fahrenheit, surrounding its enemies and encasing them in ice.

pokedexEntries.or: The diamond-shaped crystals on its body expel air as cold as -240 degrees Fahrenheit, surrounding its enemies and encasing them in ice.

pokedexEntries.y: Using its diamond-shaped crystals, it can instantly create a wall of ice to block an opponent’s attack.

pokedexEntries.as: Using its diamond-shaped crystals, it can instantly create a wall of ice to block an opponent’s attack.

pokedexEntries.us: An Aurorus was found frozen solid within a glacier, just as it appeared long ago, which became quite a big event in the news.

pokedexEntries.um: This usually quiet and kindly Pokémon has a surface temperature of around –240 degrees Fahrenheit.

pokedexEntries.sw: Aurorus was restored from a fossil. It’s said that when this Pokémon howls, auroras appear in the night sky.

pokedexEntries.sh: When gripped by rage, Aurorus will emanate freezing air, covering everything around it in ice.

pokedexEntries.za: The diamond-shaped crystals on its body expel air as cold as −240 degrees Fahrenheit, surrounding its enemies and encasing them in ice.
